steps.title: Configure Gradle build system
steps.description: Set up root and app Gradle build configuration with Java 8 compatibility and Android SDK 34 targets.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure application permissions for audio playback, network streaming, and wake lock support.

steps.title: Define UI color palette and themes
steps.description: Create high-contrast dark tuner display colors, neon accents, and material styling for the FM radio.

steps.title: Design tuner and LCD display vector assets
steps.description: Build custom drawables for digital frequency screen, control buttons, visualizer bars, and dial markers.

steps.title: Implement Radio Station data model
steps.description: Create structured radio station model with frequency, station callsign, genre, and stream URLs.

steps.title: Build dynamic Equalizer Visualizer custom view
steps.description: Implement a real-time retro LCD spectrum visualizer view using Android Canvas rendering.

steps.title: Create Radio Playback and Tuning Controller
steps.description: Implement native MediaPlayer streaming, tuner scanning logic, frequency stepping, and audio state management.

steps.title: Design comprehensive Radio UI layout
steps.description: Assemble digital frequency readout, analog tuning scale, frequency seek controls, presets, and audio controls.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity tuner interactions
steps.description: Connect tuner slider, auto-seek scanner, preset storage, volume controller, and sleep timer.

steps.title: Building FM Radio
steps.description: Compile and assemble the debug APK for the FM Radio application.
